thread:
sara: quick flag for the migration guide: customers using v1 model aliases like `stable-eng-1` are going to get confused when the v2 examples show full model ids. can we add a section on alias mapping?
ethan: yep saw support tickets about that. what do you want the copy to say?
sara: short paragraph + code snippet showing a mapping table and fallback example. something like:
```
// v1 alias -> v2 model name map
const MODEL_MAP = { 'stable-eng-1': 'redwood-stable-1.0', 'fast-gen': 'redwood-fast-0.9' }
const model = MODEL_MAP[legacyAlias] || legacyAlias
const resp = await client.generate({ model, input })
```
vishal: also call out the behavioral change: `chat.send()` was removed in v2; `generate()` is unified for chat/text. put a little note under Breaking Changes.
anya: and please update the API header example. some pages still show `X-Api-Key`. v2 docs should use `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. customers copy/paste these headers into automated scripts.
sara: good point. i'll add that. planning to open PR tonight.
docs-bot: lint-check: new doc section added to migrations.md at line 312. link-checker: found 1 broken link -> /sdk/auth -> should be /sdk/authentication.
ethan: thanks docs-bot. include the corrected anchor and add a redirect note in the changelog. ops asked to keep redirects for 30 days.
vishal: also request: can we include a quick shell example for curl showing both old and new header formats so SREs can validate scripts quickly? 2 lines max.
sara: good idea. will add curl snippet and a markdown table mapping old->new functions.
anya: when you open the PR tag me, i'll verify wording for enterprise customers. we should avoid saying "removed" without offering a migration path.
sara: noted. PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4721 includes alias mapping, header fix, curl example, and changelog bullet.
docs-bot: PR #4721 checks: markdown-lint ok, link-checker fails -> fixed in patch 2?
sara: pushed patch 2 resolving link anchor and adding the curl example.
docs-bot: PR #4721 merged by ethan 6a. deploy scheduled.
ethan: added a one-liner in releases.md: "Deprecated: v1 model aliases; use explicit v2 model names or the provided alias map."
vishal: thanks team. small docs tweak, big reduction in support noise.
anya: cheers, everyone :)
